additional_info.subject: ID0475819-DC/Si-D/FR-[MP / P0 170001115] Terminal Status Monitoring Error CRM:03431000004
additional_info.body:
Dear Pierre-Antoine,
We've investigated the green LED remaining on the DC1 outlet, despite the charging cable being stolen. The cause is a sensor malfunction related to the cut cable, which is incorrectly keeping the LED active.
To resolve this, the charging cable for the DC1 outlet needs to be replaced. This will correct the sensor's state and restore normal operation.
Best regards,
Ivan
Siemens eMobility Technical Support Team
